ios.desc:
Plan your hunt and find more success in the field with onX Hunt. Access 1.8 billion acres of public land, 161.5 million private properties, and 15,880 unique hunting units. Use GPS navigation, 3D offline maps, and localized species data to know where you stand.

Understand the landscape with Satellite, Lidar Topo, and Hybrid Basemaps. Save Offline Maps and feel confident in your backup plan with onX SOS. Research property lines and locate hunting properties to avoid accidental trespassing. Monitor optimal weather conditions and find new opportunities nationwide with custom Map Layers.

Keep your hunt safe, organized, and efficient. View Trail Cameras for recent activity, display routes on your vehicle dash, and sync industry-leading rangefinders and binoculars. See your hunting group’s live locations and share Map Markups with nearby devices.

Trusted by 5,000 game wardens, find more game and hunt smarter with onX Hunt.

onX Hunt Features:

▶ What tools can I use to prepare for the hunting season?
Stack the odds in your favor with Hunt Research Tools. Use onX Hunt on desktop to know your draw odds, tag trends, and harvest statistics. Access Huntin’ Fool’s expert research as an Elite member and set reminders for application deadlines.

▶ How do I know where I can legally hunt?
Use private land boundary data with landowner names to know where you stand (U.S. only). Identify GMUs, Hunting Units, public land, and state land hunting maps. View terrain with 3D Lidar Topo, Satellite, and Hybrid Basemaps. Add Waypoints and set Optimal Wind conditions.

▶ How can I customize and share my hunt?
Hunt smarter with terrain analysis tools and scout any tag with state-specific Map Layers. Research conditions, cell coverage, access points, wildlife, soil, and more. Collaborate by sharing Hunt Areas or Tracks, and see your partners move with live, session-based Location Sharing.

▶ Can I navigate without cell service and hunt alone safely with onX Hunt?
Download Offline Maps to view the details you need, no matter where you are. Monitor localized weather forecasts and record your path. Maintain your bearings with our built-in GPS and pinpoint areas using Compass Mode. Unlock onX SOS to access professional dispatch and rescue coverage.

▶ Which tools does onX Hunt integrate with?
Display maps on your vehicle’s dash with Apple CarPlay and mark your location from your wrist using Apple Watch. Drop Waypoints automatically by syncing with compatible rangefinders and binoculars.
